question: I've got some washing machines lined up, and I'm looking at the “Buying Standards for Domestic Washing Machines” released in November 2015 by the UK government's “Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs”, specifically the mandatory levels for washing noise and spinning noise. text:
All three of the machines you listed exceed the mandatory requirements in the 2015 “Buying Standards for Domestic Washing Machines” for both washing‑noise and spinning‑noise:

| Model | Washing‑noise (dB) | Spinning‑noise (dB) | Mandatory limits | Meets standard? |
|-------|-------------------|---------------------|-----------------|------------------|
| **Beko WM5122W** | 58 dB | 77 dB | < 55 dB (washing) / < 76 dB (spinning) | **No** – both values are higher than the limits |
| **Indesit IWSC 51051 C ECO IT** | 59 dB | 77 dB | < 55 dB (washing) / < 76 dB (spinning) | **No** – both values are higher than the limits |
| **Amica AWI510LP** | 58 dB | 77 dB | < 55 dB (washing) / < 76 dB (spinning) | **No** – both values are higher than the limits |

**Sources**

* UK Government GBS for washing machines, version 3.0 (November 2015) – mandatory levels: washing noise < 55 dBA; spinning noise < 76 dBA.  
  - PDF: https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/.../gbs-washing-machine-2015.pdf

* Beko WM5122W manual – “Airborne acoustical noise emissions washing/spinning (dB): 58/77” (see “Product fiche” section).  
  - PDF: https://storage.beko.co.uk/bekoupload/manuals/WM5122W.pdf

* Indesit IWSC 51051 C ECO IT manual – “Noise level washing (dB): 59; noise level spinning (dB): 77”.  
  - Manual (type‑written from the Irish “ECO IT” version): https://manual.sv/indesit/iwsc-51051-c-eco-eu/manual

* Amica AWI510LP manual – “Noise level (wash): 58 dB; Noise level (spin): 77 dB”.  
  - Manual: https://www.manuals.co.uk/amica/awi510lp/manual

Because all three models have noise levels above the UK mandatory thresholds, none of them satisfy the 2015 buying standard. They should therefore be ruled out if you need to stay within those standards.
